author: GoPro
description:
Two riders. Two winning runs. One unforgettable day at the 2026 @ucichannel MTB World Championships. 🏆

Experience GoPro Athletes' @jacksongoldstone6453's and @valihoell's  Elite Downhill World Championship-winning runs from their GoPro HERO13 Black Ultra Wide Editions, captured at Val di Sole, Italy.

From the start gate to the finish, watch the runs that put Goldstone and Höll on top of the podium at one of the biggest events in downhill mountain biking. No edits. No distractions. Just full-speed, raw POVs from the Elite Men's and Elie Women's Downhill races on the legendary Black Snake course. At 1.43 miles (2.3km) long with 1,804ft (550m) of vertical descent, Black Snake is one of downhill mountain biking’s most demanding and iconic tracks.

For more MTB madness 👉 @GoProBike
